goal_ru: После урока ты сможешь сказать, какая еда есть дома, и спросить, есть ли что-то.
can_do_en: I can talk about food at home and ask if there is any.

words.note_ru: Жидкости не считаются: нельзя «a milk», «two milks».

grammar.explain_ru: Есть вещи, которые можно посчитать: an egg, two eggs, some apples. А есть «вещество», его не считают: milk, water, bread, cheese, rice, meat — у них нет a и нет -s. Хлеб — именно так: bread, а не breads! Про такое «немного / сколько-то» — some: There's some milk. There are some eggs. В вопросах и с not — any: Is there any cheese? There aren't any bananas.
grammar.explain_en: Countable: an egg, some eggs. Uncountable: some milk, some bread (no a, no -s). Use any in questions and negatives: Is there any juice? There isn't any bread.

examples.en: There's some cheese, but there isn't any bread.
Are there any eggs? — Yes, there are six.
Is there any milk? — No, the fridge is empty.

mistakes.right: some bread / a loaf of bread
some cheese / two pieces of cheese

grammar.tutor_notes_ru: Дать два столбика: «считаем» / «не считаем», ученик раскладывает. Some в вежливых просьбах (Would you like some tea?) — отложить на кафе. Пересечение с There is/are из m2.

questions_en: What's in your fridge right now?
What do you usually eat after school?
Is there any ice cream at home?
What do you have for breakfast?
talk.tutor_notes_ru: Ловить «a bread», «breads». Нейт: «Breads? How many breads, exactly?».

tasks.text: There's ___ milk, but there aren't ___ eggs. Is there ___ cheese?

tasks.answer: Is there any juice in the fridge?

tasks.ask_ru: Послушай маму (без текста). Что нужно купить?
tasks.audio: We've got some eggs and some cheese, but there isn't any bread and there isn't any milk. Can you buy them after school?
tasks.question: Что купить?

tasks.text: Есть немного курицы и риса, но нет помидоров.
answers: There's some chicken and rice, but there aren't any tomatoes.
There is some chicken and some rice, but there aren't any tomatoes.

tasks.ask_ru: Открой холодильник на картинке: что есть, чего нет?

image.prompt_en: An open fridge with a carton of milk, six eggs, a piece of cheese, two tomatoes, a yoghurt and some sausages, but no bread and no fruit, bright flat illustration, no text
image.alt_ru: Открытый холодильник: молоко, шесть яиц, кусок сыра, два помидора, йогурт, сосиски; хлеба и фруктов нет.

tasks.say: What's in the fridge? What isn't there?
tasks.example: There's some milk and some cheese. There are six eggs and two tomatoes. There's a yoghurt. There are some sausages. There isn't any bread and there aren't any apples.

tasks.ask_ru: Что сейчас в твоём холодильнике? 4–5 фраз.
tasks.say: Imagine you open your fridge now. What's there?
tasks.example: There's some milk and some butter. There are some eggs. There isn't any juice. There's some pasta from yesterday.

tasks.say: Is there any milk? — No, the fridge is empty.

homework.about_ru: Загляни в холодильник по-настоящему и надиктуй список покупок по-английски: что есть, чего не хватает.

tasks.ask_ru: Список: что есть и что купить.
tasks.say: What's at home, and what do we need to buy?
tasks.example: There's some cheese and some eggs. There isn't any bread. We need some bread, some milk and some bananas.

pass.about_ru: Пройден, если верно 75% заданий и в описании холодильника (t7) нет «a bread / some milks».

review.note_ru: like/don't like о еде (A0) + There is/are.
